h2: Ultrasonic testing in Charlotte: flow-accelerated corrosion, boiler work and fabrication QA
html:
Ultrasonic testing in Charlotte: flow-accelerated corrosion, boiler work and fabrication QA

Outside nuclear programs, most ultrasonic testing around Charlotte supports boilers, pressure vessels and steam-cycle piping at utility and industrial plants, and weld quality on fabricated steel. Atlantis sends UT crews from Houston to sites in North and South Carolina, with procedures and reports reviewed by an ASNT NDT Level III, and quotes each scope after reviewing drawings and access.

Flow-accelerated corrosion. In fossil and combined-cycle steam cycles, carbon steel feedwater, condensate, extraction steam and heater drain lines thin from the inside where flow is disturbed, at elbows, tees, reducers and downstream of control valves. FAC programs find it with grid UT thickness surveys: a fixed grid marked on each component, read at the same points every outage, so the wear pattern and rate can be calculated rather than guessed. The work depends on accurate grid layout, on gauges calibrated to ASTM E797 practice, and on tying every reading to the component's identity in the program database.

Boiler and pressure work under North Carolina's rules. In North Carolina, boilers are regulated by the Department of Labor's Boiler Safety Bureau. UT supplies the thickness and weld evidence behind repairs and inspections: waterwall and economizer tube readings, header and drum checks, and examination of repair welds. Because North Carolina operates its own State Plan, workplace safety on UT jobs, including work at height on boiler scaffolds, is enforced by the state program rather than by federal OSHA directly.

Fabrication QA. Shops in the region building to ASME Section VIII or AWS D1.1 use UT for plate lamination checks and for weld examination. ASME Section VIII allows ultrasonic examination in place of radiography for certain welds when the procedure and personnel meet its added requirements, typically using encoded phased array or TOFD with a permanent data record. That avoids a radiation boundary in a busy shop; North Carolina is an NRC Agreement State, so radiography there also brings a state license and radiation safety program into the job.

  • FAC grid surveys on feedwater, condensate and extraction piping
  • Boiler tube and header thickness during outages
  • PAUT or TOFD on vessel and piping welds in place of RT where the code allows
  • Lamination checks on plate before cutting and welding
  • Automated corrosion mapping on vessel shells and tanks

Nuclear in-service inspection is a separate regime with its own qualification requirements; the nuclear NDT consulting page covers how an ASNT NDT Level III supports it. For conventional work, see ultrasonic testing, phased array inspection services, TOFD testing and pressure vessel inspection. Grid readings only become a trend when each one lands on the same point every outage, which is what Atlantis ERP keeps. Technicians can take UT training or see the Charlotte NDT training page. To scope a job, send isometrics, drawings and outage dates through the Charlotte UT request.
